quotes.text: Implement a facade or adapter layer between different subsystems that don't share the same semantics.
Communication between subsystem A and the anti-corruption layer always uses the data model and architecture of subsystem A.
the core purpose of an anti-corruption layer is to protect the domain model

preservedTechnicalReading.adopted: Business-facing communication can use the business model; external-facing calls use the external model. An adapter can provide translation at a protective boundary.
preservedTechnicalReading.limits: Adapter and anti-corruption layer are not synonyms. ACL is a domain-protection architectural purpose and can contain an adapter or facade. This example does not claim to implement a complete production ACL. Document discussion of latency, maintenance and semantic differences also applies; no blanket need for an ACL for every wrapper.

quotation.originalCompleteParagraph: The diagram shows an application that has two subsystems. Subsystem A calls subsystem B through an anti-corruption layer. Communication between subsystem A and the anti-corruption layer always uses the data model and architecture of subsystem A. Calls from the anti-corruption layer to subsystem B conform to that subsystem's data model or methods. The anti-corruption layer contains all the logic necessary to translate between the two systems. You can implement the layer as a component within the application or as an independent service.
